*HDFC Bank Panchkula — 9:30 AM Morning Huddle*
Edition: 2026-11-28 (8:00 PM IST Intel)

1) *Sales Hook:* Rate Pitch: "Bank of India raises MCLR on overnight, one-month loans; revised rates effective December 1" (CNBC-TV18 — Personal Finance & Insurance) — The revised rates will come into effect from December 1, 2026.

2) *Competitor Counter:* Peer Counter: "SBI to up lending under 'MSME Dream' to Rs 50 cr by March 2027" (Economic Times — Banking & Finance) — Counter across Panchkula with HDFC Bank's faster digital sanction TAT, CMS/working-capital bundling, and Imperia/Preferred relationship depth.

3) *Ops & Compliance Alert:* Frontline Policy + Compliance: (1) Brief every PB/Teller on "HDFC Bank to stop SMS alerts for UPI payments up to ₹500 from January 1, 2027"; (2) Flag RBI update "RBI Issues Amendment Directions on ‘Suspected Money Mule Accounts to Prevent Cyber-enabled Financial Frauds’" for strict counter & audit discipline.

4) *Insurance / TPP Focus:* Wealth & NRI Talking Point: "Auction of State Government Securities" — equip RMs for HNI, treasury, and NRI client conversations.

— BM Desk · Verified Official & Tier-1 Sources

*Team Desk Note — HDFC Bank Update (2026-11-28)*
Topic: HDFC Bank to stop SMS alerts for UPI payments up to ₹500 from January 1, 2027

• Customers making UPI payments of ₹100, ₹200, ₹400 or ₹500 will not receive an SMS alert from the bank after completing the transaction.
• However, those making payments exceeding ₹500 will continue receiving SMS notifications.

*Action at Counters:* Brief PBs/Tellers ahead of Jan 1, 2027: guide walk-ins to HDFC MobileBanking & email alerts for UPI ≤ ₹500.
Source: CNBC-TV18 — Personal Finance & Insurance
